caveats: Shown in the KAM view only, never in the Customer view or the exported review.
Customer priorities and industry have no effect: every Customer gets the same inputs and thresholds.
catalogue.definition: Worst-of rating from the inputs: the worst input rating, naming every input that is amber or red. An input under its minimum volume is not rated and drops out. With no rated input, account health is not rated, never green. A Customer is rated from its own aggregate values, never from its Site ratings. A Site is rated on on-time service cycle share and scan coverage only.
catalogue.name: Account health
catalogue.rationale: No public benchmark exists. Set at about 2 times the 2025 synthetic spread. Replace with the contract SLA in production.

caveats: Amber means about twice the 2025 late share of 1.7%.
Based on a sample of tracked garments.
catalogue.definition: On-time service cycle share over the period, from the Customer's or Site's own cycles. Green at 97% or more, amber from 95% to under 97%, red under 95%. Not rated under 100 sampled cycles.
catalogue.name: Account health on-time service cycle share
catalogue.rationale: No public benchmark exists. Set at about 2 times the 2025 synthetic spread. Replace with the contract SLA in production.

caveats: Amber means about twice the top of the 2025 Customer range.
Not used for Sites: every Site raises 14 to 38 service requests a year whatever its size, so the rate at Site grain mostly measures Site size.
catalogue.definition: Service requests divided by wearer-months, times 100. Wearer-months are the monthly average active wearers times the number of months. Green at 1.0 or less, amber over 1.0 to 2.0, red over 2.0. Not rated under 1,000 wearer-months. Customer only.
catalogue.name: Account health service requests per 100 wearers per month
catalogue.rationale: No public benchmark exists. Set at about 2 times the 2025 synthetic spread. Replace with the contract SLA in production.

caveats: Set just below the lowest Site-year, and low on purpose: no scan activity does not prove that a garment is not needed (customer brief note 2).
catalogue.customer_question: Are we using the service effectively?
catalogue.definition: Active assets scanned divided by allocated pieces over the period. Green at 80% or more, amber from 70% to under 80%, red under 70%. Not rated under 500 allocated pieces, monthly average.
catalogue.name: Account health scan coverage
catalogue.rationale: No public benchmark exists. Set at about 2 times the 2025 synthetic spread. Replace with the contract SLA in production.

customer_experience_gap.text: Customer Experience (CSAT, NPS) is a data gap: the workbook holds no survey results. It is shown beside the rating and is never an input.
